name: @arena/escalation-adapters
description: Escalation wire-transport adapters (Work Order C001; issue #75; spec/expert-escalation-api.md ES1.0): signed webhook delivery with deterministic retry/backoff and dead-letter state (at-least-once, eventId consumer dedupe) over the services/escalation-api webhook outbox, plus the MCP stdio transport binding over the MCP tool layer. Pure structural ports — zero workspace runtime dependencies (architecture-lock rule 10: adapters never leak into domain packages; boundary rule B4: adapters never import services).
